summary.text: Systems-oriented Route-to-Market Analyst with experience leading a three-person team across three entities in West Java. I turn inconsistent field processes into standardized, measurable ways of working, including a Call Frequency Management framework across 32 depots and data-driven anomaly detection that identified and deactivated more than 12,000 suspicious outlets. I combine a data science foundation with hands-on field experience and stakeholder coordination so analysis leads to changes teams can apply in daily operations. Guided by “Quam plurimi et quam aptissimi,” I keep learning and focus on lasting, measurable impact.

experience.company: Tirta Utama Abadi (Danone Distributor, West Java)
details: Identified anomalies in transaction patterns and geolocation data, then deactivated more than 12,000 potentially fraudulent outlets. This cleaned the outlet base used for coverage and incentive decisions.
Standardized field-ready visit planning across all 32 depots in West Java, supporting double-digit profit growth at nearly every depot.
Lead a three-person team across three entities, maintaining clear sales territories and consistent execution standards.
Rebuilt daily sprint dashboards so every depot can access live performance data without manual compilation.
Automated market-potential and distance-to-outlet analysis for new openings, saving the team about 8.6 hours each month.
Analyze monthly fleet needs by depot and channel, combining sales targets with the previous month’s fleet data to align delivery capacity with expected demand.
Conduct market analysis, including trade economics, to inform depot coverage, new outlet openings, and channel decisions.
Automated manual reporting workflows in Excel, eliminating approximately 12 hours of manual data entry per week.
Partnered with Finance, Sales, and Operations to design systems and standardize SOPs, replacing fragmented department-level practices with consistent cross-functional standards.
Drove sales through direct customer engagement, consistently working toward and achieving monthly sales targets.
Assessed customer credit applications using 7C and 5S principles, safeguarding receivables quality while keeping approval turnaround efficient.
Followed up on overdue customer accounts through structured payment discussions and documented commitments to support timely repayment.
Led a 34-member council across 10 divisions, introducing KPI-based performance tracking to establish clear accountability per division.
Designed school-wide programs that the school leadership later adopted as ongoing initiatives.
Led outreach campaigns at 12 partner schools to increase student engagement and recruitment.
Established weekly inter-division coordination meetings, reducing miscommunication and missed deadlines.

impact.title: Reporting Automation System
impact.desc: The weekly reporting process at Home Digital required extensive manual data entry, reformatting, and cross-checking. I redesigned the Excel workflow to run with minimal intervention, saving the team about 12 hours each week.

impact.title: KPI-Based Governance Leadership
impact.desc: Led a 34-member student council across 10 divisions using KPI-based performance tracking and weekly coordination meetings. The school leadership adopted several programs, and outreach activities reached 12 partner schools.
